question:
Three resistors have the following magnitudes.

R1 = 30 Ω ± 5%, R2 = 60Ω ± 5%, R3 = 50Ω ± 5%

Determine the magnitude of limiting resultant resistance when all three resistances are connected in series.
solution:
The correct answer is __140 ± 7Ω__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When resistors are connected in series__, the total resistance is the sum of their individual resistances.
 
• For three resistors in series: **R = R1 + R2 + R3.**
 
• Given: **R1 = 30Ω ± 5%, R2 = 60Ω ± 5%, R3 = 50Ω ± 5%**.
 
• Total resistance: **R = 30 + 60 + 50 = 140Ω**.
